Dari menyusuri gemerlap jalanan malam Nanbin Road berlatar megahnya Jembatan Dongshuimen dan kilau emas Hongyadong, berlanjut menikmati hidangan hotpot khas Chongqing di tebing ruang terbuka sambil memandang panorama sungai dan kemegahan gedung Raffles City 🇨🇳🌌  #traveltiktok #scenery #cinematic #chinesevibes #china

📍Chongqing, China. When most people think of a super futuristic city like this, they think of the neon lights, robotic taxis, and advanced technology. But this view leaves out the most important element of any destination: the people.

It turns out that even in a cyberpunk city that looks straight out of a sci-fi movie, the formula for a great Friday night is completely universal—good music, grilled food, cold drinks, and great company 🍻

We often travel halfway around the world expecting to document the massive differences between places, only to realize that our everyday human experiences are incredibly similar 🌏 Seeing this in chongqing reminded me of many places I've seen people hanging out at across the world - whether at beaches in Europe, small towns in vietnam, or slow moving river banks in Texas (my home state).

Will travel unreasonable distances for a cool coffee shop

Welcome to possibly the most stunning coffee shop I’ve ever seen, MoYe Cliff Coffee (also known as Qiya Coffee) at the MoYe Snow Mountain Cliff Hotel in the middle Tiger Leaping Gorge area between Linang and Shangri-La in the Yunnan Province of China! This cliffside coffee shop has floor to ceiling windows, modern decor, and 10/10 coffee creating a spot worth hiking 11 miles to. 

Most people fly into lijang and complete the 2 day 15 mile trek along the high trail of Tiger Leaping Gorge to get here. Luckily, you can get dropped off via car at multiple different spots of this trail so you can make the hike as short as you’d like using private drivers. This coffee shop is located in the middle section of the Gorge but despite the name, this is usually where most people end their two day hike. If you can afford it (our room was $400 a night which is very expensive for China prices) I’d HIGHLY recommend staying at the MoYe Snow Mountain Cliff Hotel as a reward for completing the hike. Link to book this hotel is in my bio!!

I’ll be sharing more about this hotel and the entire 2 day trek soon so follow along if you don’t want to miss it! 

If you aren’t much of a hiker you *can* actually get a private driver (like a didi or local) to drive you directly to the door of this hotel but the road is steep and windy with over 20 switchbacks so be ready for a wild ride! If you’re coming from Lijang it’ll be about 2.5 hours and will cost anywhere from $40-$80USD. Most visitors get here via the hike and I Would recommend reaching it via the hike since it is part of the fun and the trail is so stunning!

📍 Shiziguan, China 🇨🇳 Senzația incredibilă de a conduce pe apă: Podul Plutitor Shiziguan din China! 🇨🇳🚗🌊
Ascuns într-o vale spectaculoasă din provincia Hubei, Podul Plutitor Shiziguan (cunoscut și ca „Aleea pe Apă”) oferă una dintre cele mai unice experiențe rutiere din lume!
🛣️ CURIOZITĂȚI DESPRE PODUL SHIZIGUAN:
 Dimensiuni: Are o lungime de aproximativ 500 de metri și o lățime de 4,5 metri, fiind construit peste un râu cu apă de un verde smarald intens.
 Inginerie plutitoare: Structura folosește pontoane din polietilenă de înaltă densitate (HDPE) acoperite cu scânduri din lemn.
 Efect de unduire: Când mașinile trec pe pod, acesta creează valuri line în apă, oferind senzația de glisare pe suprafața râului.

❌ NOT WORTH IT
💎 “Friend Price” Jade — Be careful with deals that sound too good to be true.

🧳 Traveling During Golden Week — Huge crowds, long lines, and packed attractions.

20 things to do in China 🇨🇳 :

1. Furong Zhen: spend a night in this ancient village and enjoy the peaceful vibes at sunset 🌅

2. Zhangjiajie: explore the breathtaking “Avatar Mountains” with towering sandstone pillars 🏞️

3. Chongqing: wander through the neon streets of this cyberpunk city at night 🌆

4. Qingshan Green Lake: stroll along the lake and enjoy the serene greenery 🍃
5. 72 Wonder Tower: party with locals and see the city lights from above ✨

6. Longjing Tea Fields: sip fresh tea in the lush plantations 🍵

7. Great Wall of China: slide down sections of this iconic wonder 🧱

8. Fenghuang Ancient Village: get lost in winding streets and riverside scenery 🏘️

9. Hong’en Temple at night: see the temple beautifully illuminated after dark 🕯️

10. Chinese food: try everything from spicy hotpot to dumplings and street snacks 🍜

11. Chengdu: meet the giant pandas and learn about conservation 🐼

12. The Bund, Shanghai: stroll along the riverside at night and admire the skyline 🌃

13. Leifeng Pagoda: climb this historic pagoda and take in views of West Lake 🕍

14. Liziba Station: watch the famous train pass through a building 🚆

15. Glass Bridge: walk across the Zhangjiajie Glass Bridge 🌉

16. Beijing Roast Duck: taste this iconic dish in the city where it all began 🦆

17. West Lake, Hangzhou: relax by the water, rent a boat, or enjoy a sunset stroll 🌅

18. Get lost in random streets: sometimes the best discoveries are off the beaten path 🚶‍♂️

19. People’s Park: dance or join locals for morning exercises 💃

20. Nature escapes: hike mountains, wander forests, or just enjoy the fresh air 🍃

Trying traditional Chinese medicine in Shanghai 🇨🇳

If you’re visiting China, add a traditional Chinese medicine massage to your itinerary! I visited Yu Health in Shanghai for a massage and moxibustion treatment, and it was definitely different from your typical spa experience.

I deal with constant neck and back pain, so I was curious to experience these traditional techniques firsthand.

My experience included:

- Traditional Chinese medicine massage using targeted pressure to work on areas of tension. They can actually tell you what’s wrong with your body based off feel
- 1 hour of moxibustion, a treatment that uses heat from burning mugwort near specific points on the body. Traditionally used in TCM for muscle and joint discomfort, circulation, digestive concerns, and overall energy balance

It wasn’t the most relaxing massage I’ve ever had, but it was helpful (the moxibustion part is relaxing tho!!)

3️⃣ Como tudo é por app, é imprescindível ter internet. Então compre um chip local ou um chip internacional.

5️⃣ O transporte público funciona muito bem nos grandes centros, então use e abuse de metrô e/ou ônibus. De preferência metrô por conta do trânsito. Lembre-se de validar na entrada e saída do transporte

6️⃣ Evite a Muralha da China na segunda-feira! Como muitos museus estão fechados na segunda, vai todo mundo pra lá! E muitos chineses mesmo vão visitar, então fica lotado!

7️⃣ Preparem-se para seus dias de fama! Serão parados na rua o tempo todo para tirar fotos! Principalmente pelas crianças. Eles são muito curiosos e não estão tão acostumados com estrangeiros.
